name: visionbridge-monorepo
description: Voice-First, AI-Assisted Preliminary Vision-Screening and Optometrist-Connect Platform

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,AI" -c "blue,teal,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=server run typecheck && npm --workspace=client run typecheck
